# Pull request

## Summary

<!-- What does this change, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Fix a broken link, typo, or formatting issue
- [ ] Correct or update technical content
- [ ] Add or improve a learning resource
- [ ] Add or improve a roadmap, guide, project, drill, or template
- [ ] Improve automation or repository infrastructure
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Safety and accuracy

- [ ] All offensive content is limited to owned systems, deliberately vulnerable apps, or explicitly authorized labs.
- [ ] I have removed secrets, personal data, client data, and internal hostnames.
- [ ] External links use canonical HTTPS URLs and are not affiliate, referral, or piracy links.
- [ ] Cost and access labels are accurate; freemium resources state what is free.
- [ ] Claims are supported by official documentation or other authoritative sources.
- [ ] The content is original or properly attributed and licensed.

## Quality checks

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run lint:md`
- [ ] `npm run check:links`
- [ ] `npm run check:links:external` (or explain why not run)
- [ ] `npm run spellcheck` (reviewed remaining warnings)
- [ ] I checked the rendered Markdown and internal anchors.
